    ents[n]? = some e) : mvcc.restoreLastRev (List.take (n + 1) ents) = e.rev.main

    mvcc.KvEnt} (he : ents[n]? = some e) {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hm : ∃ e', e' ∈ List.take n ents ∧
    ki.modified = e'.rev) : ki.modified.lt e.rev

theorem mvcc.rstLInv_set {L : List mvcc.IdxEntry} {pre : List mvcc.KvEnt} (h : mvcc.rstLInv L pre)
    {i : Nat} {z : mvcc.IdxEntry} (hz : L[i]? = some z) (e : mvcc.KvEnt) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (hg :
    ki.gens ≠ []) (he : mvcc.kiIsEmpty ki = false) (hm : ki.modified = e.rev ∨ ki.modified =
    z.snd.snd.modified) : mvcc.rstLInv (L.set i (z.fst, z.snd.fst, ki)) (pre ++ [e])

theorem mvcc.take_succ_of_getElem? {ents : List mvcc.KvEnt} {n : Nat} {e : mvcc.KvEnt} (he :
    ents[n]? = some e) : List.take (n + 1) ents = List.take n ents ++ [e]

theorem mvcc.rstCacheOk_btInsert {L : List mvcc.IdxEntry} {c : GMap GoString Loc} (h :
    mvcc.rstCacheOk L c) (p : Loc) (k : GoString) (m : mvcc.KeyIndex) (hnew : ∀ (w : mvcc.IdxEntry),
    w ∈ L → mvcc.entryLess w (p, k, m) ∨ mvcc.entryLess (p, k, m) w) : mvcc.rstCacheOk (btInsert
    mvcc.entryLess (p, k, m) L) <[k := p]>c

theorem mvcc.restoreLastRev_le {ents : List mvcc.KvEnt} (hs : mvcc.RestoreEntsOk ents) (n : Nat) {e
    : mvcc.KvEnt} (he : ents[n]? = some e) : sint.Z (mvcc.restoreLastRev (List.take n ents)) ≤
    sint.Z e.rev.main

def mvcc.rstLInv (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (pre : List mvcc.KvEnt) : Prop :=
  ∀ (z : mvcc.IdxEntry),
    z ∈ L →
      z.fst ≠ null ∧ z.snd.snd.gens ≠ [] ∧ mvcc.kiIsEmpty z.snd.snd = false ∧ ∃ e, e ∈ pre ∧ z.snd.snd.modified = e.rev

theorem mvcc.idxRestore_take_succ {ents : List mvcc.KvEnt} {n : Nat} {e : mvcc.KvEnt} (he : ents[n]?
    = some e) : mvcc.idxRestore (List.take (n + 1) ents) = mvcc.idxRestoreEnt (mvcc.idxRestore
    (List.take n ents)) e

theorem ownBTree.congr_simp {T' : Type} [ZeroVal T'] [TypedPointsto T'] (T T✝ : go.GoType) (e_T : T
    = T✝) [IntoValTyped T' T] {V : Type} (t t✝ : Loc) (e_t : t = t✝) (isItem isItem✝ : T' → V →
    IProp GF) (e_isItem : isItem = isItem✝) [∀ (p : T') (v : V), Persistent (isItem p v)] (less
    less✝ : V → V → Prop) (e_less : less = less✝) (items items✝ : List V) (e_items : items = items✝)
    (dq dq✝ : DFrac) (e_dq : dq = dq✝) : ownBTree T t isItem less items dq = ownBTree T✝ t✝ isItem✝
    less✝ items✝ dq✝

def mvcc.rstCacheOk (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (cache : GMap GoString Loc) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : GoString) (p : Loc), cache !! k = some p → ∃ ki, (p, k, ki) ∈ L

theorem mvcc.rstLInv_mono {L : List mvcc.IdxEntry} {pre : List mvcc.KvEnt} (h : mvcc.rstLInv L pre)
    (e : mvcc.KvEnt) : mvcc.rstLInv L (pre ++ [e])

theorem mvcc.find?_of_mem_sorted {L : List mvcc.IdxEntry} : List.Pairwise mvcc.entryLess L → ∀ {z :
    mvcc.IdxEntry}, z ∈ L → List.find? (fun w => decide (w.snd.fst = z.snd.fst)) L = some z

theorem mvcc.itemsOfEntries_set_same (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) {i : Nat} {z : mvcc.IdxEntry} (hz :
    L[i]? = some z) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.itemsOfEntries (L.set i (z.fst, z.snd.fst, ki)) =
    mvcc.itemsOfEntries L
